source: Directive tables of the Bareos 25.1.2 Director as carried by odir (crates/odir/src/commands/show_items.rs) plus Onesimus extensions (crates/odir/src/config_check.rs EXTENSIONS)
description: The Catalog resource describes the PostgreSQL database that holds the job, file and volume records.

examples.title: The catalog on the local PostgreSQL server

directives.name: Name
directives.description: Name of the catalog; Client and Pool resources and the use command refer to it.

examples.console: configure add catalog name=MyCatalog dbuser=bareos dbname=bareos
configure add catalog name=MyCatalog dbuser=bareos dbname=bareos description="Main catalog"

directives.name: DB Address
directives.description: Host of the PostgreSQL server; without it (and without DB Socket) the local socket is used.

examples.console: configure add catalog name=MyCatalog dbuser=bareos dbname=bareos dbaddress=db.example.com

directives.name: DB Port
directives.description: TCP port of the PostgreSQL server.

examples.console: configure add catalog name=MyCatalog dbuser=bareos dbname=bareos dbport=5432

directives.name: DB Password
directives.description: Password of the database user. The Onesimus Director masks it (***) in show.

examples.console: configure add catalog name=MyCatalog dbuser=bareos dbname=bareos dbpassword=db-secret

directives.name: DB User
directives.description: Database user the Director connects as.

examples.console: configure add catalog name=MyCatalog dbname=bareos dbuser=bareos
configure add catalog name=MyCatalog dbuser=bareos dbname=bareos

directives.name: DB Socket
directives.description: Directory of the PostgreSQL Unix socket, instead of a TCP connection.

examples.console: configure add catalog name=MyCatalog dbuser=bareos dbname=bareos dbsocket=/var/run/postgresql

directives.name: Disable Batch Insert
directives.description: Deprecated: insert file records one by one instead of in batches.

directives.name: Reconnect
directives.description: Reconnect automatically when the database connection breaks.

examples.console: configure add catalog name=MyCatalog dbuser=bareos dbname=bareos reconnect=yes

directives.name: Exit On Fatal
directives.description: Stop the Director on a fatal database error instead of carrying on.

examples.console: configure add catalog name=MyCatalog dbuser=bareos dbname=bareos exitonfatal=no

directives.name: Min Connections
directives.description: Connections the connection pool opens at start.

examples.console: configure add catalog name=MyCatalog dbuser=bareos dbname=bareos minconnections=1

directives.name: Max Connections
directives.description: Upper limit of the connection pool.

examples.console: configure add catalog name=MyCatalog dbuser=bareos dbname=bareos maxconnections=5

directives.name: Inc Connections
directives.description: How many connections the pool opens at once when it grows.

examples.console: configure add catalog name=MyCatalog dbuser=bareos dbname=bareos incconnections=1

directives.name: Idle Timeout
directives.description: Seconds after which an idle pooled connection is closed.

examples.console: configure add catalog name=MyCatalog dbuser=bareos dbname=bareos idletimeout=30

directives.name: Validate Timeout
directives.description: Seconds after which a pooled connection is checked before use.

examples.console: configure add catalog name=MyCatalog dbuser=bareos dbname=bareos validatetimeout=120

directives.name: Db Driver
directives.description: Onesimus extension: accepted so that older configurations that still name the driver load; Bareos 25 removed the directive. The catalog is PostgreSQL.
